_comment: Curated Qwen3-TTS model variants for the dashboard. Only includes model IDs verified against the official Qwen3-TTS HuggingFace releases. Used by web_ui/static/app.js to render a <select> for --qwen3-tts-model-name and to flag which downstream fields (ref_audio, ref_text, instruct) are required per variant. Speaker names live in web_ui/static/field_choices.json (--qwen3-tts-speaker, 9 names, both CustomVoice variants). Supported languages per speaker are documented inline in web_ui/static/qwen3_voice_library_ui.js (native sample sentences). Cloning (ref_audio on Base models) and voice-design (instruct text on VoiceDesign) paths require ABI v2 symbols not yet in the public qwentts.cpp source -- we set needs_abi_v2 on those variants so the UI can show a banner explaining the limitation.

models.label: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B CustomVoice (preset speakers, no reference audio needed)
Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 0.6B CustomVoice (smaller, faster, same 9 preset speakers)
Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B Base (voice cloning via reference audio + reference text — requires ABI v2)
Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B VoiceDesign (synthesize a new voice from a text instruct prompt — requires ABI v2)
Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 0.6B Base (smaller, voice cloning — requires ABI v2)
